offers.label: Workshop credit of $40
offers.detail: A goodwill credit toward a service or parts, valid for 12 months. Offered when a return is not eligible.

mandate: Made-to-order wheel builds and cut-to-length parts are not returnable for change of mind (clause 4.1). When the computed outcome is not eligible for that reason, you may offer our published goodwill option once: offer id workshop-credit-40, a $40 workshop credit valid for 12 months. If the customer reports a fault, explain that the workshop warranty (clause 3.3) covers it and that they can file a faulty claim instead.
service_info: Warranty repairs take about ten working days from arrival. We pay return shipping for faults. Workshop credit is issued the same day as confirmation.
greeting: Hi. I can help with our wheel builds and parts, find your order, check a return, and, if you disagree with a returns decision, take the case to the Open Resolution Desk.
cannot_do: real payments or shipping (this is a fictional demo shop)
